notes: The id, createdAt, and updatedAt system columns are supplied by n8n and are not declared here.

Data Tables provide no unique constraint, multi-statement transaction, or row lock. Correctness relies only on single-statement filtered UPDATEs (version-guarded compare-and-set and the delivery claim) plus readers that use only the highest schedule_version per subject.

Changes from 2A-6: cims_reminder_schedules gains last_execution_id (distinguishes 'applied' from a replayed 'duplicate'); cims_reminder_events becomes an append-only receipt log written AFTER the schedule decision, so payload_fingerprint and failure_code were removed.
recipient_email is cleared on cancellation. Delivery logs never store the email address or message body. No table stores a raw webhook body, signature, or secret.

tables.name: cims_reminder_schedules
tables.purpose: Current reminder state per subject_key plus delivery state. May contain duplicate rows for one subject; only the highest schedule_version counts.

tables.name: cims_reminder_events
tables.purpose: Append-only receipt log: one row per acknowledged delivery attempt (applied, duplicate or stale). Rejected requests are not logged.

tables.name: cims_reminder_delivery_logs
tables.purpose: Append-only delivery attempt audit metadata written by Workflow B.
